"Create a 3D mobile voxel-based Real-Time Strategy (RTS) and Sandbox Castle-Building game inspired by \"Castle Story\".

### 1. High Concept @COMMENT_BODY@ Core Loop
- **Theme:** Fantasy sandbox set on floating sky islands.
- **Core Loop:** Gather resources (wood, stone, crystals) -> Assign miniature cute voxel workers -> Build custom stone/wood fortifications block-by-block -> Craft weapons/tools -> Defend against waves of corrupted shadowy monsters at night.
- **Tone @COMMENT_BODY@ Style:** Bright, charming, stylized low-poly voxel art with vibrant colors (similar to Bricktrons from Castle Story), day/night lighting, and soft shadows.

### 2. Platform @COMMENT_BODY@ Mobile-First Controls (Touch UX)
- **Camera:**
  - One-finger drag to pan across the island.
  - Two-finger pinch to zoom in/out.
  - Two-finger twist to rotate the isometric view.
- **Unit @COMMENT_BODY@ Building Controls:**
  - Tap a worker or drag-box select multiple workers.
  - Contextual radial action menu on long-press (Chop, Mine, Build, Fight, Patrol).
  - Tap-and-drag grid placement for blueprints (walls, stairs, doors, bridges). Workers automatically claim tasks from the queue.
  - Speed-up button (1x, 2x) and a \"Pause @COMMENT_BODY@ Plan\" tactical mode.

### 3. Core Mechanics

#### A. Workers @COMMENT_BODY@ Jobs System
- Cute humanoid voxel creatures with autonomous pathfinding (NavMesh).
- Dynamic Roles:
  - **Lumberjack:** Chops trees, carries logs to stockpiles.
  - **Miner / Quarry Worker:** Digs terrain and stone blocks.
  - **Builder:** Transports materials and constructs placed blueprints block-by-block.
  - **Warrior / Archer:** Equipped at an armory to defend the castle perimeter.

#### B. Voxel Building @COMMENT_BODY@ Physics
- Grid-based block placement (wood planks, stone bricks, defensive ramparts, wooden stairs).
- Simplified Structural Integrity: Blocks need foundational support connected to the ground or island bedrock. If critical support pillars are destroyed, unsupported upper blocks crumble with physics particles.

#### C. Enemies @COMMENT_BODY@ Wave Defense (Invasion Mode)
- **Day Cycle:** Safe period for gathering, quarrying, and architectural expansion.
- **Night Cycle:** Corrupted shadow creatures spawn from dark rifts and march toward the player's core crystal.
- Enemy types:
  - Swarmers (fast, low HP, attack workers).
  - Breakers (heavy, prioritize breaking defensive walls).
  - Ranged Spitters (attack from afar).

### 4. Technical @COMMENT_BODY@ Mobile Optimization
- Chunk-based voxel terrain rendering to maintain high FPS on mid-range mobile devices.
- Capped unit count (e.g., maximum 12–15 friendly units and 20–30 enemies per wave) to avoid CPU bottlenecks.
- Simplified physics: Use visual dust/rubble particles instead of full individual rigidbodies when walls collapse.

### 5. Starting Scene @COMMENT_BODY@ Prototype Deliverable
- Spawn one medium-sized floating island with green grass, exposed stone deposits, and a grove of pine trees.
- 4 starting yellow voxel workers, 1 town hall/core stockpile containing starting wood and stone.
- A functional UI bar at the bottom: [Build Wall], [Build Stairs], [Chop Area], [Mine Area], [Recruit Worker].
- A 3-minute daytime countdown timer leading to a small 5-enemy test wave.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"
